node.timingScope: Single run observation; not a model, P0 or latency acceptance metric.
additionalChecks: Production supplier URLs require HTTPS or explicit loopback and reject invalid URLs.
Production construction enforces supplier routing; default development compatibility is retained.
Vision and ASR requests enforce redirect:error.
Synchronous private-scope checks reject natural session expiry and committed data epoch changes.
Capability invalidation during actual cache rename atomically rolls back the prior committed data; the rejected candidate is absent in memory, on disk and after restart.

staticChecks.initialCheckFalsePositive: A simulated relative import inside a test string was parsed as an actual file reference. Constructing the same string via importLine resolved the false reference without changing the checker or assertions.

artifactScope: Counts and commands only. Full test logs with private fixtures are not copied.
